verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists a built-in "Gemini AI assistant in Gmail," and a Workspace update mentions Meet's "Take notes for me" settings, which is a concrete task handed off to built-in AI. Both are only one-line mentions, so the depth and breadth of task delegation are unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of what tasks the assistant can carry out, coverage across Docs/Sheets/Drive, multi-step or agentic delegation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: New Google Meet 'Take notes for me' settings for admins and end users take effect September 29th
